unresolved.reason: The current official General Security visitor rules do not establish an ordinary Israeli-passport visitor route. The generic residual rule cannot safely resolve a possible Israel-specific admission restriction, and the project taxonomy has no entry_prohibited status. Do not recast the fallback visa_required label as an established ordinary visitor-visa rule.

Article Eight grants Ghanaian tourists a one-month border visa subject to ticket, accommodation/contact and funds conditions, while Article Ten is headed for female Ghanaian citizens and requires prior General Security authorisation using broader citizens wording. The current page does not establish one gender-neutral ordinary-passport status.

Article Eight grants Egyptian tourists a one-month border visa subject to ticket, accommodation/contact and funds conditions, while Article Ten is headed for female Egyptian citizens and requires prior General Security authorisation using broader citizens wording. The current page does not establish one gender-neutral ordinary-passport status.

Article Two gives Iraqis a broad automatic one-month tourist visa, while the later Article Eight describes automatically issued Iraqi visas only for traders, doctors and engineers with occupation-specific conditions. The current official page does not reconcile the scopes, so it does not establish one nationality-only ordinary-passport status.
